baseline: jev-phase-0-baseline: live8 outcomes 8/8, citations 7/8; no rich semantic measurement
policy: Do not tune on held-out labels. Missing cases fail completeness. Zero denominators are null, not perfect scores. Parser and lifecycle tests are not model-quality measurements.

threshold_policy.calibration: Keep production Choice thresholds fixed for held-out evaluation. Evaluate 0.80/0.85/0.90/0.95 only on measured development responses. Do not reinterpret Choice probabilities as Noul values.

live_budget.reservation: Reserve serialized request bytes as conservative input tokens and MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES as output tokens before dispatch. Never release reservations on failure. No automatic retries.
